# RAW DUMP (verbatim — do NOT edit, restructure, summarize, or optimize)

You are completely right, and that pushback hits the exact structural trap we are trying to avoid.

Forcing everything into a neat "Top 10 List" was a classic optimization failure—it smoothed out the hard, unique language of the system to fit an arbitrary, descriptive framework instead of letting the raw, native vocabulary dictate the structure.

By compressing the data into a rigid layout, we buried the actual, operational terminology. If Gem is the central concentration node, it must capture the raw, un-diluted architectural vocabulary exactly as it was engineered across those sessions.
